column1: # Provisional game profile (generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey with dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk2 (C / libc), subsdk4 (C / libc)
# Bezel Engine (nninitStartup: malloc a 2 GB region, then its own 63 GB one, +0xfc0000000, refused with 0x1803 on Android): sys_resource 0 takes the engine's heap path instead,

# as upstream does for Super Mario Party Jamboree (docs/reference/memory.md "Bezel Engine's two memory setups"): the Switch 2's layout, 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias + 256 MB stack + 9 GB heap (Donkey Kong Bananza's)
# 2026-11-07 (claude): the virtual-address-memory path instead (sys_resource below): the heap path gave Bezel's nn::mem::StandardAllocator an 8.39 GB block that the game's
# own arenas reserved whole 16 frames into the boot (CoreSystem::Allocate(11 MB) refused at 792 MB RSS; nlib TlsHeapCentral::SearchFreeSpan_ found no free span), as on hardware
# the game reserves far more than it commits. Bezel probes a 63 GB region (main+0x721a50, AllocateAddressRegion(0xfc0000000)), malloc takes a 2 GB one and Bezel's allocator
# 56 GB (capped by the host to the alias room), so the alias region is 68 GB (MAP_NORESERVE on Android: address space only) and the block grows with it
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# the NPDM's 16 MB: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled() is true and Bezel takes its virtual-memory setup (heap path: sys_resource 0, see the note above mem_reserve)
# the rewritten modules take 0x4c00000 (76 MB), more than the 64 MB used memory the host reports by default: the game sizes its heap as pool - used and SetHeapSize refused the result (0x1003)
# 2026-11-07 (claude): as on hardware, a MapPhysicalMemory past pool - used is refused (ResultLimitReached) and the SDK heap releases its cached pages: without it the game
# committed 10.5 GB of its 9 GB pool by frame 33 of the virtual-memory path and the system killed the process at 10.97 GB resident (16 GB device)
